title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Image | Page 1
text:
[IMAGE] This image appears to be a portrait of Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz, a prominent 17th-century mathematician and philosopher.

Leibniz is well-known for his independent co-development of calculus alongside Isaac Newton, which is a fundamental concept in mathematics. Although this image itself does not illustrate a mathematical concept directly, it serves as a visual representation of one of the key figures in the history of calculus, differential equations, and mathematical logic. His contributions laid the groundwork for much of modern mathematical analysis and problem-solving techniques.
